question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Ignision ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is '**ignition**'. • **Ignition **means the process of starting a fire or combustion. (आग या दहन शुरू करने की प्रक्रिया) • **For example**: *The ignition of the campfire required some kindling and a match.* • The incorrect spelling 'ignision' has an extra '**i**' between '**g**' and '**n**'. • The mistake is a common misspelling error due to the similar sound of '**i**' and '**g**'. • To avoid such errors, it is important to practice spelling and pay attention to the correct sequence of letters. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Horticulture **is the science of plant cultivation. (बागवानी पौधों की खेती का विज्ञान है) • **Copulate **means to engage in sexual intercourse. (संभोग में संलग्न होना) • **Portion **is a part or share of something.
